name: Graeme Henderson
story: Graeme Henderson's geospatial career includes work at Eagle Technology in Wellington. He studied at the University of Stirling from 1999 to 2003. His customer work described in the history places him among the practitioners who helped translate GIS software into operational systems for infrastructure organisations.

By 2011, Graeme Henderson was working with Downer on the ArcGIS configuration for GRAIL, described in Eagle Technology’s case study as Downer’s first GIS system. Eagle appointed him Chief Executive Officer on 15 December 2025, following more than ten years of leadership experience at the company.

Eagle’s commercial GIS history links early figures such as Parker Jones and David Pimblott with later enterprise work by Graeme Henderson, Scott Campbell, Jithen Singh, Trevor Hart and Nathan Heazlewood.
